roles.sees: candidate label + task + raw output + primary findings
roles.mission: seek concrete mathematical/logical errors and unsupported claims
recompute deterministic arithmetic/algebra checks independently where applicable

independence_rules: Same model lineage or copied reasoning is not independent evidence
No candidate identity before score freeze
No aggregate winner is promoted automatically
Every penalty requires an explicit evidence reference
Unknown or unverifiable claims remain UNVERIFIED, not PASS

T03: scope does not claim conjecture false
T06: all four evidence classes correctly distinguished

freeze_rule: Any protocol change after scoring begins requires v2 and rerun of all candidates.
